meta.title: Travel KG — Explore Kyrgyzstan
meta.description: Discover Kyrgyzstan with Travel KG: mountain trails, lakes, canyons, and local guided trips.
placeData.ala-archa.name: Ala-Archa National Park
placeData.ala-archa.description: Gentle alpine trails, a panoramic waterfall, and crisp air beneath the snowy peaks of the Tien Shan. A perfect first journey in Kyrgyzstan.
placeData.pio-peak.name: Lenin Peak and the Meridian Trail
placeData.pio-peak.description: Take on one of Kyrgyzstan’s best-known peaks: glaciers, a high mountain pass, and views across ridgelines stretching to the horizon.
placeData.asan-basky.name: Asan-Basy Valley
placeData.asan-basky.description: A peaceful valley among high pastures and snowy slopes, ideal for a short but rewarding mountain escape.
placeData.lenin-trail.name: Tien Shan Trail to Kel-Suu Lake
placeData.lenin-trail.description: Alpine meadows, mountain passes, and a clear high-altitude lake make this a memorable route for nature lovers and photographers.
placeData.issyk-kul.name: Lake Issyk-Kul
placeData.issyk-kul.description: Wake beside a vast mountain lake, sandy beaches, and snow-covered ridgelines. Discover welcoming guesthouses and local culture along the way.
placeData.son-kul.name: High-Altitude Lake Son-Kul
placeData.son-kul.description: Experience nomadic life at 3,016 metres: yurts beneath the stars, horseback rides, and a quiet you will never forget.
placeData.chatyr-kul.name: Lake Chatyr-Kul
placeData.chatyr-kul.description: One of the country’s best-known high-altitude lakes, with open skies, fresh mountain wind, wide views, and nights in traditional yurts.
placeData.kashka-suu.name: Kashka-Suu Lake and Mountain Escape
placeData.kashka-suu.description: An easy trip with time to relax by the water, walk to a waterfall, and enjoy a peaceful day outdoors with the family.
placeData.jyrgalan.name: Jyrgalan Valley
placeData.jyrgalan.description: Green pastures, snowy peaks, and trails away from the usual tourist routes. A wonderful place for a walk in the mountain air.
placeData.ala-kul.name: Trek to Ala-Kul Lake
placeData.ala-kul.description: A hiking route over mountain passes, alpine meadows, and steep slopes, ending beside a crystal-clear lake.
placeData.kara-mazar.name: Kara-Mazar Trail
placeData.kara-mazar.description: A peaceful route along flower-filled mountain slopes, with riverside stops and a comfortable pace for hikers of different abilities.
placeData.seren-peak.name: Trek in the Seren Mountain Range
placeData.seren-peak.description: For travellers seeking a true adventure: steep climbs, wild landscapes, and starry nights high in the mountains.
placeData.skazka.name: Fairy Tale Canyon
placeData.skazka.description: Red rock formations beside Issyk-Kul seem to come alive at sunset. An easy walk with unforgettable views for your camera.
placeData.toraygyr.name: Toraygyr Canyon
placeData.toraygyr.description: Sandstone walls and sunlit multicoloured dunes create a striking setting for an active day and memorable photos.
placeData.jeti-oguz.name: Jeti-Oguz Canyon
placeData.jeti-oguz.description: A vivid mix of canyon scenery and dramatic rock formations, explored at a comfortable pace with beautiful stops along the way.
placeData.myn-tala.name: Myn-Tala Canyon
placeData.myn-tala.description: A comfortable, scenic day among rock formations and ever-changing landscapes, with plenty of striking viewpoints.
placeData.sary-chet.name: Sary-Chet Saymalik Canyon
placeData.sary-chet.description: A demanding yet rewarding route over rugged terrain, with cliffs, mountain passes, and far-reaching panoramic views.
placeData.song-kul-horse.name: Horseback Ride in the Tien Shan
placeData.song-kul-horse.description: Spend a day in the saddle on ancient mountain trails. Your experienced guide will tailor the route to your ability and share local nomadic traditions.
placeData.rafting-chui.name: Rafting on the Chuy River
placeData.rafting-chui.description: A lively ride down the river, mixing exciting rapids with calmer stretches and gravelly banks for a dynamic day outdoors.
placeData.paragliding.name: Paragliding above Lake Issyk-Kul
placeData.paragliding.description: Soar above bright blue water with snowy peaks on the horizon—one of Kyrgyzstan’s most scenic adventures.
placeData.horse-steppe.name: Nomad Trail on Horseback
placeData.horse-steppe.description: Meet local families, spend the night in a yurt, and ride across open steppe to experience the daily life and culture of nomadic communities.
placeData.mountain-bike.name: Mountain Bike Ride over a Steep Pass
placeData.mountain-bike.description: For riders who love an active challenge: steep descents, front-row views of the ridgelines, and a night at a mountain camp.
